title: Log training to W&B from the Spark image
summary: The Spark image provides wandb 0.28.2, so training can opt in to RSL-RL W&B logging through prepare. Runs default to offline files inside the run output; online runs take WANDB_API_KEY by name from the launcher environment. ppo_config stays unchanged for checkpoint loading. The host uploader is removed, and .gitattributes keeps only rules that match tracked files.
next: Prepare the next training allocation with --logger wandb and a project name.
reason: Run tracking changes no measured result, roadmap marker or gate.
